name.description:
If no fields are populated on the Genai.LlmGuardrails.Processor, it will not be correctly persisted on
{@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Manager#inputProcessors} or {@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Manager#outputProcessors},
so this field exists to ensure that all processors are correctly persisted.

promptParamsToScan.description: The values of {@link Genai.Prompt#params} to scan.

categories.description:
This is assumed to be an array of category names.
If no categories are specified, all four categories are used. Azure utilizes multiple categories to get scores in a single request.
Based on the categories specified, the API will return #severityLevel scores for each category.

blocklistNames.description:
Represents text blocklist names. Only support following characters: 0-9 A-Z a-z - . _ ~. We can attach multiple list names here.
It works along with #haltOnBlocklistHit which decides whether to halt the analysis when blocklist name/s is hit.

haltOnBlocklistHit.description:
When set to true, further analyses of harmful content won't be performed in cases where #blocklistNames are hit.
 When set to false, all analyses of harmful content will be performed, whether or not blocklists are hit.

severityLevel.description:
Specifies the severity level scale to use for content moderation:
"FourSeverityLevels": Uses 4 discrete levels (0, 2, 4, 6)
"EightSeverityLevels": Uses 8 discrete levels (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)
Based on these severity levels, we can filter the input content.

severityLevelThreshold.description:
The threshold for the severity level. If the severity level is below this threshold, the input is considered safe and if it is above this threshold, the input is considered harmful.
The severity level threshold can take the following values based on the severity level:
If severityLevel = "FourSeverityLevels", severityLevelThreshold can be 0, 2, 4, 6. (6 is the most severe).
If severityLevel = "EightSeverityLevels", severityLevelThreshold can be 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. (7 is the most severe).
If the severity level is -1, then the default threshold is used.
Default threshold is 4 for "FourSeverityLevels" and 6 for "EightSeverityLevels".
